title.gu: યુનિટ 5 Notes — Rate Analysis ની પ્રક્રિયા

h.gu: 5.1 Rate analysis ની વ્યાખ્યા, હેતુ અને components

body.en:
Rate analysis determines the reasonable cost per unit of an item from its specification, material consumption, labour productivity, equipment, transport and applicable overheads, taxes and contractor’s profit. It supports SOR preparation, a non-SOR rate, tender pricing and checking quotations. The measurement unit, rate inclusions and specification define the result; a ₹/m³ concrete rate cannot be compared with an RCC rate that also includes reinforcement or shuttering unless adjusted.

Base rates should be current, local, documented and consistent with the authority’s SOR and contract. An illustrative class example is not a current Gujarat R&B rate. Sustainable choices should meet performance and safety requirements while considering lifecycle impacts and verified local supply.
body.gu:
Rate analysis માં item ની specification, material consumption, labour productivity, equipment, transport અને લાગુ overheads, taxes તથા contractor profit પરથી પ્રતિ unit વાજબી ખર્ચ નક્કી થાય છે. તે SOR preparation, non-SOR rate, tender pricing અને quotation checking માં મદદ કરે છે. Measurement unit, rate inclusions અને specification પરિણામ નક્કી કરે છે; reinforcement અથવા shuttering સહિતના RCC rate સાથે સામાન્ય ₹/m³ concrete rate સુધારા વગર સરખાવી શકાય નહીં.

Base rates current, local, documented અને authority ના SOR તથા contract સાથે સુસંગત હોવા જોઈએ. શૈક્ષણિક ઉદાહરણ current Gujarat R&B rate નથી. Sustainable વિકલ્પોમાં performance તથા safety સાથે lifecycle impacts અને ચકાસેલ local supply પણ જુઓ.

items.syllabus_item: 5.2 5.6 lead standard extra lift transportation and equipment hire

body.en:
Lead is the distance of material transport along the applicable measured route; lift is vertical movement as defined in the item or contract. Standard or initial lead/lift may already be included in an SOR rate; extra lead/lift is priced only as permitted beyond that allowance. State source, route, quantity, distance, handling and inclusions. Road condition, loading, unloading, royalties and local restrictions can affect cost.

Equipment cost depends on hire rate, productive hours, output, fuel, operator, maintenance and mobilisation; check which are included in the hire rate. Convert the total cost to the item unit and use realistic productivity. Never add haulage or fuel twice if already included.
body.gu:
Lead એ લાગુ measured route પર material transport નું distance છે; lift એ item અથવા contract પ્રમાણે vertical movement છે. SOR rate માં standard/initial lead-lift પહેલેથી સામેલ હોઈ શકે છે; તેની બહારનું extra lead/lift ફક્ત મંજૂર હોય ત્યારે price કરો. Source, route, quantity, distance, handling અને inclusions દર્શાવો. Road condition, loading, unloading, royalties અને local restrictions ખર્ચ બદલી શકે છે.

Equipment cost hire rate, productive hours, output, fuel, operator, maintenance અને mobilisation પર આધારિત છે; hire rate માં શું સામેલ છે તે તપાસો. કુલ ખર્ચ item unit માં ફેરવો અને વાસ્તવિક productivity લો. Haulage અથવા fuel અગાઉથી સામેલ હોય તો ફરી ઉમેરશો નહીં.

body.en:
1. Fix the exact item description, specification, unit, location, working conditions and measurement/payment basis. 2. Take material quantities per unit including justified conversion, wastage and moisture; multiply each by delivered cost, identifying included transport. 3. Estimate skilled and unskilled labour hours or days from actual productivity, wage and working conditions. 4. Add equipment hire and remaining transport, testing, water, taxes and overheads only as applicable.

5. Calculate contractor’s profit on the specified cost base, not an assumed universal base; list each percentage and base explicitly. 6. Divide by the quantity analysed, check units and compare with authorised SOR and current quotations. Never silently adopt a dry-volume factor, labour output, GST percentage or profit percentage as universally mandated.
body.gu:
1. ચોક્કસ item description, specification, unit, location, working conditions અને measurement/payment basis નક્કી કરો. 2. પ્રતિ unit material quantities માં યોગ્ય conversion, wastage અને moisture સામેલ કરો; દરેકને delivered cost થી ગુણો અને સામેલ transport ઓળખો. 3. વાસ્તવિક productivity, wage અને કામની સ્થિતિ પરથી skilled તથા unskilled labour hours/days શોધો. 4. Equipment hire અને બાકી transport, testing, water, taxes તથા overheads ફક્ત લાગુ હોય ત્યાં ઉમેરો.

5. Contractor profit નિર્ધારિત cost base પર ગણો, સર્વત્ર સમાન base ધારીને નહીં; દરેક percentage અને base સ્પષ્ટ લખો. 6. Analysed quantity થી ભાગી units ચકાસો અને authorised SOR તથા current quotations સાથે સરખાવો. Dry-volume factor, labour output, GST અથવા profit percentage ને સૌ માટે ફરજિયાત માની ન લો.

h.en: 5.4 Task work, labour and plant productivity
h.gu: 5.4 Task work, labour અને plant productivity

items.syllabus_item: 5.4 5.5 task work labour categories wages and number

body.en:
Task work is an assumed or observed quantity of work completed by a worker or crew in a standard time under defined conditions. It may be stated as output per worker-day, crew-day or machine-hour; translate the chosen basis consistently into labour-days per item unit. Skilled labour may include mason, carpenter, bar bender and machine operator; unskilled or semi-skilled workers assist handling and placement. Wages and output depend on locality, time, skill, height, access, method and project rules.

For a crew paid ₹3,000/day producing 5 m³/day, labour cost is ₹600/m³, if that crew’s full cost covers only the specified operation. Actual task-work tables and wages must come from current authorised SOR or local verified data; they are not universal constants. Check whether mixing, curing, scaffolding and safety are included in the productivity and rate.
body.gu:
Task work એ નિર્ધારિત conditions હેઠળ worker અથવા crew નિશ્ચિત સમયમાં કરેલું assumed અથવા observed work quantity છે. તે worker-day, crew-day અથવા machine-hour દીઠ output તરીકે હોઈ શકે છે; યોગ્ય basis ને સુસંગત રીતે labour-days પ્રતિ item unit માં ફેરવો. Skilled labour માં mason, carpenter, bar bender અને machine operator હોઈ શકે છે; unskilled અથવા semi-skilled workers handling તથા placing માં મદદ કરે છે. Wages અને output locality, time, skill, height, access, method અને project rules પર આધારિત છે.

₹3,000/day ખર્ચવાળો crew 5 m³/day કરે તો labour cost ₹600/m³ છે, જો crew નો આખો ખર્ચ ફક્ત આપેલ operation માટે હોય. Actual task-work tables અને wages current authorised SOR અથવા ચકાસેલ local data પરથી લો; તે universal constants નથી. Mixing, curing, scaffolding અને safety productivity/rate માં સામેલ છે કે નહીં તપાસો.

h.en: 5.5 Analysing earthwork, concrete, RCC and masonry
h.gu: 5.5 Earthwork, concrete, RCC અને masonry નું analysis

items.syllabus_item: 5.7 preparing rate analysis earthwork concrete RCC brickwork and sustainable materials

body.en:
Earthwork: identify soil classification and excavation method, labour/plant output, lead/lift, disposal, shoring and dewatering as specified. PCC: estimate cement and aggregates from approved mix or supplied consumption, allow justified conversion from wet concrete to constituent volumes, then add water, mixing, placing and curing costs if not included. A teaching dry-volume factor is an assumption, not a universal code rule.

RCC: concrete, reinforcement and formwork may be separate BOQ items or combined by contract. For separate items prepare concrete cost per m³, steel cost per kg including fabrication/placing when specified, and formwork cost per m²; do not add them to a rate that already includes them. First-class brickwork: compute net masonry, bricks, mortar ingredients and workmanship according to the item; verify brick dimensions, joints, wastage, scaffolding and curing. Recycled aggregate, supplementary cementitious materials or alternative products can be considered only when tested, specified and permitted; compare verified delivered and lifecycle costs without inventing a performance benefit.
body.gu:
Earthwork: Soil classification અને excavation method, labour/plant output, lead/lift, disposal, shoring તથા dewatering specification મુજબ ઓળખો. PCC: Approved mix અથવા આપેલ consumption પરથી cement અને aggregates શોધો; wet concrete થી constituents ના volume માટે યોગ્ય conversion લો; પાણી, mixing, placing અને curing cost પહેલેથી સામેલ ન હોય તો ઉમેરો. Teaching dry-volume factor એક assumption છે, universal code rule નહીં.

RCC: Concrete, reinforcement અને formwork BOQ માં અલગ અથવા contract મુજબ combined હોઈ શકે છે. અલગ items હોય તો concrete પ્રતિ m³, steel પ્રતિ kg (લાગુ હોય તો fabrication/placing સહિત) અને formwork પ્રતિ m² ગણો; પહેલેથી સમાવિષ્ટ rate માં ફરી ઉમેરશો નહીં. First-class brickwork: Item પ્રમાણે net masonry, bricks, mortar ingredients અને workmanship શોધો; brick dimensions, joints, wastage, scaffolding તથા curing ચકાસો. Recycled aggregate, supplementary cementitious materials અથવા alternatives ફક્ત tested, specified અને permitted હોય ત્યારે લો; ચકાસેલ delivered અને lifecycle costs સરખાવો, performance benefit ગઢશો નહીં.

title.en: Lead and lift in material transport
title.gu: Material transport માં lead અને lift
Numerical 5.1 — 1 m³ PCC માટે rate analysis

body.en:
Given: Teaching assumptions: 1 m³ of 1:2:4 concrete, dry-volume factor 1.54, cement density 1440 kg/m³ and 50 kg/bag; cement ₹380/bag, sand ₹1500/m³, coarse aggregate ₹1200/m³, labour ₹800 and plant ₹300. Water charge is 1% of direct subtotal, overhead 5% of direct subtotal and profit 10% of direct subtotal plus those two charges. No other costs or taxes included; not an SOR rate.

Step 1. Find ingredient volumes from the assumed 1:2:4 ratio.

Sum of proportion = 1 + 2 + 4Sum of proportion = 7Cement volume = 1.54 / 7Cement volume = 0.22 m³Sand volume = 1.54 × 2 / 7Sand volume = 0.44 m³Coarse aggregate volume = 1.54 × 4 / 7Coarse aggregate volume = 0.88 m³

Step 2. Convert cement to bags.

Cement mass = 0.22 × 1440Cement mass = 316.8 kgCement bags = 316.8 / 50Cement bags = 6.336

Step 3. Price the constituents and direct costs.

Cement cost = 6.336 × 380Cement cost = ₹2407.68Sand cost = 0.44 × 1500Sand cost = ₹660Coarse aggregate cost = 0.88 × 1200Coarse aggregate cost = ₹1056Direct subtotal = 2407.68 + 660 + 1056 + 800 + 300Direct subtotal = ₹5223.68

Step 4. Calculate the stated water, overhead and profit bases.

Water charge = 0.01 × 5223.68Water charge = ₹52.2368Overhead = 0.05 × 5223.68Overhead = ₹261.184Profit base = 5223.68 + 52.2368 + 261.184Profit base = ₹5537.1008Profit = 0.10 × 5537.1008Profit = ₹553.71008Rate = 5537.1008 + 553.71008

Final answer:

Illustrative rate ≈ ₹6,090.81/m³ before unlisted tax.
body.gu:
આપેલ છે: શૈક્ષણિક assumptions: 1 m³ 1:2:4 concrete, dry-volume factor 1.54, cement density 1440 kg/m³ અને 50 kg/bag; cement ₹380/bag, sand ₹1500/m³, coarse aggregate ₹1200/m³, labour ₹800 અને plant ₹300. Water charge direct subtotal ના 1%, overhead direct subtotal ના 5% અને profit direct subtotal સાથે આ બંને charges ના સરવાળાના 10% છે. અન્ય costs કે taxes સામેલ નથી; આ SOR rate નથી.

Step 1. આપેલ 1:2:4 ratio પરથી ingredient volumes શોધો.

Sum of proportion = 1 + 2 + 4Sum of proportion = 7Cement volume = 1.54 / 7Cement volume = 0.22 m³Sand volume = 1.54 × 2 / 7Sand volume = 0.44 m³Coarse aggregate volume = 1.54 × 4 / 7Coarse aggregate volume = 0.88 m³

Step 2. Cement ને bags માં ફેરવો.

Cement mass = 0.22 × 1440Cement mass = 316.8 kgCement bags = 316.8 / 50Cement bags = 6.336

Step 3. Constituents અને direct costs ની કિંમત ગણો.

Cement cost = 6.336 × 380Cement cost = ₹2407.68Sand cost = 0.44 × 1500Sand cost = ₹660Coarse aggregate cost = 0.88 × 1200Coarse aggregate cost = ₹1056Direct subtotal = 2407.68 + 660 + 1056 + 800 + 300Direct subtotal = ₹5223.68

Step 4. આપેલ bases પર water, overhead અને profit ગણો.

Water charge = 0.01 × 5223.68Water charge = ₹52.2368Overhead = 0.05 × 5223.68Overhead = ₹261.184Profit base = 5223.68 + 52.2368 + 261.184Profit base = ₹5537.1008Profit = 0.10 × 5537.1008Profit = ₹553.71008Rate = 5537.1008 + 553.71008

અંતિમ જવાબ:

ઉદાહરણનો rate ≈ ₹6,090.81/m³; બાકાત tax પહેલાં.

title.gu: Numerical 5.2 — Earthwork crew અને equipment નો rate

body.en:
Given: A crew costs ₹3,000/day and excavates 10 m³/day. Equipment costs ₹2,000/day for the same output. Haulage is ₹50/m³. Find direct cost per m³; no overhead, profit or tax.

Step 1. Find labour and equipment costs per m³.

Labour = 3000 / 10Labour = ₹300/m³Equipment = 2000 / 10Equipment = ₹200/m³

Step 2. Add the separate haulage.

Direct rate = 300 + 200 + 50

Final answer:

Direct cost = ₹550/m³.
body.gu:
આપેલ છે: Crew નો ખર્ચ ₹3,000/day અને excavation output 10 m³/day છે. તે જ output માટે equipment ₹2,000/day અને haulage ₹50/m³ છે. Overhead, profit અને tax સિવાય direct cost પ્રતિ m³ શોધો.

Step 1. Labour અને equipment costs પ્રતિ m³ શોધો.

Labour = 3000 / 10Labour = ₹300/m³Equipment = 2000 / 10Equipment = ₹200/m³

Step 2. અલગ haulage ઉમેરો.

Direct rate = 300 + 200 + 50

અંતિમ જવાબ:

Direct cost = ₹550/m³.

body.en:
Given: For 1 m³ first-class brickwork, assume 500 bricks at ₹8 each, prepared mortar ₹1200, labour ₹1800 and scaffolding/plant ₹300. These are supplied teaching inputs inclusive of their stated transport; no other charges or tax. Find direct rate.

Step 1. Calculate brick cost.

Brick cost = 500 × 8Brick cost = ₹4000

Step 2. Sum each cost once.

Direct rate = 4000 + 1200 + 1800 + 300

Final answer:

Direct rate = ₹7,300/m³ before unlisted charges.
body.gu:
આપેલ છે: 1 m³ first-class brickwork માટે 500 bricks ₹8 દરેક, prepared mortar ₹1200, labour ₹1800 અને scaffolding/plant ₹300 ધારો. આ શૈક્ષણિક inputs માં દર્શાવેલ transport સામેલ છે; અન્ય charges કે tax નથી. Direct rate શોધો.

Step 1. Brick cost ગણો.

Brick cost = 500 × 8Brick cost = ₹4000

Step 2. દરેક cost એક વાર ઉમેરો.

Direct rate = 4000 + 1200 + 1800 + 300

અંતિમ જવાબ:

Direct rate = ₹7,300/m³; બાકાત charges પહેલાં.

body.en:
Given: A small RCC work has 2.0 m³ concrete at ₹6500/m³, 160 kg reinforcement at ₹90/kg and 15 m² formwork at ₹600/m². Rates are assumed separate and non-overlapping. Calculate total before tax.

Step 1. Price each separately measured item.

Concrete amount = 2 × 6500Concrete amount = ₹13000Steel amount = 160 × 90Steel amount = ₹14400Formwork amount = 15 × 600Formwork amount = ₹9000

Step 2. Sum the non-overlapping amounts.

Total = 13000 + 14400 + 9000

Final answer:

Total = ₹36,400 before unlisted charges.
body.gu:
આપેલ છે: નાના RCC work માં 2.0 m³ concrete ₹6500/m³, 160 kg reinforcement ₹90/kg અને 15 m² formwork ₹600/m² છે. Rates અલગ છે અને overlap નથી એમ માનો. Tax પહેલાં total ગણો.

Step 1. અલગ માપેલા દરેક item ની કિંમત ગણો.

Concrete amount = 2 × 6500Concrete amount = ₹13000Steel amount = 160 × 90Steel amount = ₹14400Formwork amount = 15 × 600Formwork amount = ₹9000

Step 2. Overlap વગરની amounts ઉમેરો.

Total = 13000 + 14400 + 9000

અંતિમ જવાબ:

Total = ₹36,400; બાકાત charges પહેલાં.

title.en: Formulae, methods and key data — Unit 5
title.gu: Formulae, methods અને key data — યુનિટ 5

body.en:
All percentages and cost bases must be defined by the project; do not assume standard values.

Material cost = quantity per unit × delivered unit rateLabour cost per unit = crew cost per day / output per dayEquipment cost per unit = hire cost per hour / output per hourDirect cost = material + labour + equipment + remaining transportProfit = stated profit fraction × specified profit baseUnit rate = total analysed cost / analysed quantity
body.gu:
દરેક percentage અને cost base project પ્રમાણે નિર્ધારિત કરો; સર્વત્ર સમાન values ન માનો.

Material cost = quantity per unit × delivered unit rateLabour cost per unit = crew cost per day / output per dayEquipment cost per unit = hire cost per hour / output per hourDirect cost = material + labour + equipment + remaining transportProfit = stated profit fraction × specified profit baseUnit rate = total analysed cost / analysed quantity

q.en: What is rate analysis?
q.gu: Rate analysis શું છે?

a.en: Calculation of cost per unit from resource inputs and applicable charges.
a.gu: Resources તથા લાગુ charges પરથી પ્રતિ unit ખર્ચની ગણતરી.

q.en: What is lead?
q.gu: Lead શું છે?

q.en: What is lift?
q.gu: Lift શું છે?

a.en: Vertical movement as defined in the contract.

q.en: Is initial lead always extra?
q.gu: Initial lead હંમેશા extra છે?

a.en: No; it may be included in the item rate.
a.gu: નહીં; item rate માં સામેલ હોઈ શકે.

q.en: What is task work?
q.gu: Task work શું છે?

a.en: Output of a worker, crew or plant in a defined time.
a.gu: નિર્ધારિત સમયમાં worker, crew અથવા plant નું output.

q.en: What affects labour productivity?
q.gu: Labour productivity ને શું અસર કરે?

a.en: Skill, location, method and working conditions.
a.gu: Skill, location, method અને working conditions.

q.en: What are overheads?
q.gu: Overheads શું છે?

a.en: Project or business costs not directly assigned to one measured component.
a.gu: એક measured component ને સીધા ન ફાળવાયેલા project અથવા business costs.

q.en: How is contractor profit applied?
q.gu: Contractor profit કેવી રીતે લગાડાય?

a.en: On the cost base prescribed in the analysis or contract.
a.gu: Analysis અથવા contract માં નિર્ધારિત cost base પર.

q.en: Is one dry-volume factor universal?
q.gu: એક dry-volume factor સર્વત્ર લાગુ છે?

a.en: No; it is a declared approximation needing validation.
a.gu: નહીં; તે જાહેર કરેલ approximation છે અને validation જરૂરી છે.

q.en: Is steel always included in RCC concrete rate?
q.gu: RCC concrete rate માં steel હંમેશા સામેલ છે?

q.en: Why check transport inclusion?
q.gu: Transport inclusion કેમ તપાસવું?

a.en: To avoid charging the same haulage twice.
a.gu: એક જ haulage બે વાર ન ગણાય તે માટે.

q.en: Can recycled material be assumed suitable?
q.gu: Recycled material આપોઆપ યોગ્ય માની શકાય?

a.en: No; compliance, testing and approval are necessary.
a.gu: નહીં; compliance, testing અને approval જરૂરી છે.

q.en: Explain the procedure and components of rate analysis.
q.gu: Rate analysis ની પ્રક્રિયા અને components સમજાવો.

q.en: Prepare rate analysis of 1 m³ PCC from given material, labour and equipment data.
q.gu: આપેલ material, labour અને equipment data પરથી 1 m³ PCC નો rate analysis તૈયાર કરો.

q.en: Prepare rate analysis of earthwork and first-class brickwork from given data.
q.gu: આપેલ data પરથી earthwork અને first-class brickwork નો rate analysis તૈયાર કરો.

q.en: Explain RCC rate analysis and how to avoid duplication of reinforcement and formwork.
q.gu: RCC rate analysis અને reinforcement તથા formwork ની duplication ટાળવાની રીત સમજાવો.

q.en: Define lead, lift and extra lead.
q.gu: Lead, lift અને extra lead ની વ્યાખ્યા આપો.

q.en: Explain task work and factors affecting labour output.
q.gu: Task work અને labour output ને અસર કરતા factors સમજાવો.

q.en: Explain overhead charges and contractor profit bases.
q.gu: Overhead charges અને contractor profit ના bases સમજાવો.

q.en: State checks when using sustainable construction materials in rate analysis.
q.gu: Rate analysis માં sustainable materials વાપરતી વખતે કરવાના checks લખો.
